Schools Mark 80th Independence Day with Patriotic Songs and Celebrations

Multiple schools across India celebrated the 80th Independence Day with patriotic fervor. Students at Springdales School, Dhaula Kuan, participated in celebrations. The Free Press Journal highlighted a school initiative where students sang 'Saare Jahan Se Achha' to mark the occasion. These events focused on national pride and remembrance.
